pcs.pc_description: obtain the requirements of the content for publications
convert the content into draft publications to meet requirements using standard templates and tools

use AI-based layout design tools to design the layout, and publish content effectively

apply AI-enhanced tools for image editing, resizing, and enhancement to ensure all visual elements meet publication quality

conduct a quality check on content format, ensuring alignment with design standards and client requirements

ensure correct export of files to another format, such as PDF or EPS, while preserving design integrity and maintaining quality across different media
identify and rectify errors in graphics, ensuring that any inconsistencies, distortions, or issues with resolution are corrected before finalizing the design
coordinate with content creators and editors to address any content-related issues prior to publication
utilise AI tools to check for copyright compliance of all media used, ensuring that content is legally sourced

obtain approval of publications from supervisors and clients post clarifying all doubts

review the published content, if required
